tasks.goal: Search for a product (wired headphones) using the site's search
tasks.persona: A first-time visitor of americanas.com.br, a Brazilian Portuguese speaker with general familiarity with online shopping but no prior exposure to this site's interface.

steps.action: Click the search field in the page header
Type the product name into the search field
Press the Enter key to submit the search

tasks.goal: Inform a postal code (CEP) to see delivery offers for a region
tasks.persona: A first-time visitor of americanas.com.br, a Brazilian Portuguese speaker with general familiarity with online shopping but no prior exposure to this site's interface.

steps.action: Click the postal-code control in the page header
Type the postal code into the postal-code field
Click the confirmation button next to the postal-code field

tasks.goal: Browse to the smartphones category through the departments menu
tasks.persona: A first-time visitor of americanas.com.br, a Brazilian Portuguese speaker with general familiarity with online shopping but no prior exposure to this site's interface.

steps.action: Click the departments menu button in the page header
Click the smartphones category link in the departments menu

tasks.goal: Open a product from a category listing and add it to the cart
tasks.persona: A first-time visitor of americanas.com.br, a Brazilian Portuguese speaker with general familiarity with online shopping but no prior exposure to this site's interface.

steps.action: Click the first product card in the listing
Click the button that adds the product to the cart
